name: station
description: STATION — professional operating system for bartenders. V1 scope: Auth, Home, Tools, Vault.

_notes.runtime: This package.json declares zero dependencies on purpose. Everything currently runs on Node built-ins only (node:sqlite, node:test, node:http) because this repo was bootstrapped in a network-isolated sandbox — see README 'Sandbox Substitution' for the full explanation and the swap-in path to the originally-approved stack below.

intended_production_stack.http_framework: Fastify-class framework (replaces src/http/server.js's raw node:http routing)
intended_production_stack.validation: Same shared-schema approach already implemented in src/shared-kernel/validation — portable as-is
intended_production_stack.test_runner: node:test is a legitimate long-term choice and does not need replacing
